input.quote: THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY IS PROVIDED ON AN "AS IS" BASIS WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND AND LICENSOR HEREBY
input.rationale: Article VIX is a pure disclaimer: the Licensed Technology is provided "AS IS", all express and implied warranties (merchantability, non-infringement, fitness, title, accuracy) are disclaimed, and Licensor expressly does not warrant that the technology is error-free, will meet Licensee's requirements, or that nonconformities to the Documentation will be corrected. A search of the Agreement shows no affirmative Licensor performance or conformance warranty anywhere; the only "warrants" language runs against Licensee or is mutual boilerplate about counsel. This is the walk-away position under the WARRANTY rule, so we insert an express warranty (workmanlike services, 12-month conformance of the Licensed Software to the Documentation, compliance with laws, no malicious code) with a repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy, and carve it out of the disclaimer so the disclaimer does not swallow it. Fallback of 90 days/30 days is available.

proposal.summary: Add an express performance/documentation warranty with a repair-replace-refund remedy and carve it out of the "AS IS" disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article VIX currently disclaims all warranties and leaves us with no recourse if the Licensed Technology does not work as documented, so we have added an express warranty (workmanlike performance, 12-month conformance to Documentation, compliance with laws, no malicious code) with a repair, replacement or refund remedy, and carved it out of the disclaimer. If 12 months is not workable we can accept 90 days for the software and 30 days for services with the same remedies.
